about: The 15 puzzle: slide tiles into the empty space until they are in order. Easy 3x3, Normal 4x4, Hard 5x5. Every shuffle can be solved.
controls: Tap a tile next to the gap (or in its row or column) to slide it. PC: arrow keys.
name: Sliding Puzzle
tagline: Slide the tiles back into order, 1 to 15.
